verdict.rationale: AI-assistance controls are a fair question for terminal emulators, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions any AI features, AI toggles, data-egress controls, or login requirements for Alacritty. The documented features cover vi mode, search, hints, multi-window, IPC and TOML config, none of which address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use or fully disable AI features with clear control over what session data leaves my machine, without a forced login
